map.二阶系统阶跃响应中，根据超调量 M_p 求阻尼比 ζ，或反之由 ζ 计算超调与调: In the step response of a second-order system, find the damping ratio zeta from overshoot Mp, or conversely compute overshoot and settling time from zeta.
map.ζ = c/(2√(km))；ζ1 过阻尼。 示例 ζ=0.1（欠阻尼振荡）。: zeta = c/(2sqrt(km)); zeta>1 overdamped. Example zeta=0.1 (underdamped oscillation).
map.阻尼比描述二阶系统振荡衰减程度。: Damping ratio describes how fast a second-order system oscillation decays.
map.ζ = c/(2√(km))；ζ<1 振荡，ζ=1 临界，ζ>1 过阻尼。: zeta = c/(2sqrt(km)); zeta<1 oscillatory, zeta=1 critical, zeta>1 overdamped.
map.二阶系统 c、k、m 求阻尼比，判断欠/临界/过阻尼。: From c, k, m of a second-order system, find the damping ratio and classify under/critical/overdamped.
map.对比不同阻尼下的响应形态。: Compare response shapes under different damping.
map.ζ = 2 / (2×√(100×1)) = 2/20 = 0.10，属欠阻尼，: zeta = 2 / (2 x sqrt(100 x 1)) = 2/20 = 0.10, underdamped, will oscillate with overshoot.
map.若 c=20（其他不变），则 ζ=20/20=1.0，恰为临界阻尼，无振荡最快无: If c=20 (others unchanged), then zeta=20/20=1.0, exactly critical damping, fastest with no oscillation and no overshoot.
map.ζ 大小意味着什么？: What does the size of zeta mean?
map.ζ<1 欠阻尼（振荡）、ζ=1 临界、ζ>1 过阻尼（缓慢无超调）。: zeta<1 underdamped (oscillatory), zeta=1 critical, zeta>1 overdamped (slow, no overshoot).
map.欠阻尼超调多大？: How large is the underdamped overshoot?
map.最大超调 ≈ exp(−πζ/√(1−ζ²))，ζ=0.1 时约 73%。: Maximum overshoot ~ exp(-pi zeta/sqrt(1-zeta^2)), about 73% at zeta=0.1.
